en.headline: Jao Tsung-I Academy opens for Mid-Autumn lantern weekend
en.dek: The former Lai Chi Kok Hospital marks its 12th anniversary open days this weekend with hand-painted lanterns, a craft market and free heritage tours.
body: Jao Tsung-I Academy in Mei Foo is holding 12th-anniversary open days this Saturday and Sunday, and again on 25 and 26 September, with Mid-Autumn lanterns, a craft market and guided walks through the Grade III historic former Lai Chi Kok Hospital.

The academy said the grounds are open from 10am to 9pm on those four days. A market organised with LIFE MART, titled We Are Fighting Dreamers, runs from 2pm to 9pm and features local craft and food stalls, workshops and festive displays. Event listings say thousands of lanterns painted by members of the public hang across the courtyards, with lighting from this evening.

Free Cantonese heritage tours are scheduled this afternoon at 2pm and 4pm, with further slots on Sunday. Some morning tours on Sunday and 26 September are ticketed and include areas not usually open to the public. A luminous dragon dance and workshop is listed for the evening of 25 September at Block S in the middle zone.
The site is at 800 Castle Peak Road. Organisers said a free shuttle will run between D2 Place in Lai Chi Kok and the academy while the market is on. Open-day admission is free.

zh.headline: 饕館今起開放日迎中秋 花燈與市集同步
zh.dek: 美孚饕宗頫文化館十二周年開放日今明兩日及25、26日舉行，有市民繪製花燈、手作市集及免費古跡導賞。
body: 位於美孚的饕宗頫文化館本周六、日及9月25、26日舉行十二周年開放日，前荔枝角醫院三級歷史建築群會掛起中秋花燈，並設手作市集及古跡導賞。
館方資料顯示，四個開放日開放時間為上午10時至晚上9時。與LIFE MART合辦的「We are fighting dreamers」市集下午2時至晚上9時舉行，有本地文創及美食攤檔、工作坊及節日裝置。活動介紹指場內掛有市民繪製的大批花燈，由今晚起亮燈。
免費粵語古跡導賞今午2時及4時出發，周日另有場次。部分周日及26日上午時段為收費深度遊，可進入平日不對外開放的遺跡。夜光舞龍表演及體驗則訂於9月25日晚上在中區S座舉行。
地址為青山道800號。市集期間會有免費接駁車往返荔枝角D2 Place及饕館。開放日入場免費。
